description: This Java source file defines the DispatcherServlet class, which extends Spring's DispatcherServlet to provide custom initialization, reinitialization, and cleanup functionalities within the OpenMRS web application framework.

classes.name: DispatcherServlet
classes.description: Custom servlet extending Spring's DispatcherServlet to integrate with OpenMRS-specific module management and initialization routines.

methods.name: initFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Overrides Spring's initialization to set a custom class loader, refresh application context, and reload module advice.

methods.name: reInitFrameworkServlet
methods.description: Reinitializes the servlet to refresh module mappings and advice after new modules are added.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs additional startup checks, such as database updates and initialization needs.

methods.name: stopAndCloseApplicationContext
methods.description: Stops and closes the web application context managed by this servlet.
